summary.text: Heath Allbright, a Republican, has represented Alabama House District 11 since August 27, 2025, succeeding Randall Shedd, and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot for re-election.

paragraphs.text: He earned an associate degree from Northwest Shoals Community College in 2005.
His career experience includes working in forestry and as a small business owner.
